en.reason: Geoffrey Hinton rebuts Jensen Huang by noting he told roughly 1,000 machine learning researchers in 2009 that neural networks required Nvidia chips, years before Huang's 2012 call, and argues mass unemployment is a profit-driven side effect of AI giants.
